components.hypothesis: Multi-positive bidirectional state/action alignment improves ranking or generalization beyond the state-to-action NLL reference without a material calibration or selective-risk regression.
components.treatment: action NLL plus bidirectional multi-positive objective
components.development_gate: Improve the preregistered ranking/generalization metric without a material calibration/selective-risk regression.
components.rationale: Abstract synthetic fixtures validate multi-positive semantics and gradients but cannot establish a paper-level benefit.

components.hypothesis: Highest-scoring incorrect-candidate ranking improves hard-candidate discrimination beyond an equal-budget random-negative control without destabilizing calibration.
components.control: action NLL plus random-negative margin objective
components.treatment: action NLL plus deterministic hard-negative margin objective
components.development_gate: Improve hard-candidate discrimination beyond the random-negative control without a material calibration regression.
components.rationale: Synthetic fixtures validate deterministic negative selection and matched budget only; paper acceptance requires licensed development evidence.

components.hypothesis: Evidence-intervention supervision improves evidence-sensitive action behavior without exposing benchmark-only evidence relation annotations to the model input.
components.treatment: action NLL plus evidence intervention objective
components.development_gate: Any benefit must survive evidence removal/swap controls and evidence-relation input-invariance tests.
components.rationale: P04 proves the supervision/input boundary mechanically; evidence faithfulness on health data remains a later evidence gate.

components.hypothesis: Adding differentiable multiclass Brier training improves proper-scoring/calibration metrics without an unacceptable action-quality regression.
components.treatment: action NLL plus multiclass Brier objective
components.development_gate: Improve the declared NLL/Brier calibration criterion while preserving action quality within the preregistered tolerance.
components.rationale: Finite-difference gradient verification proves implementation correctness, not clinical calibration benefit.

components.hypothesis: Equal-step replay improves frozen prior-capability retention without an unacceptable target-task regression.
components.control: target-only schedule at the same optimizer-step budget
components.treatment: target schedule with a preregistered fraction of target steps replaced by replay steps
components.development_gate: Improve the frozen retention slice while preserving current-task development performance within the declared tolerance.
components.rationale: Synthetic retention validates accounting and evaluator wiring; paper acceptance requires licensed development evidence.
